description: Requires a Pro plan. Every edition one company exhibited at or sponsored, newest first (20 per page): event, year, dates, city, country, tier, booths and the edition's `as_of`. Filter by role and year range; pass `cursor` from the previous answer for the next page. `history_truncated` is set for very large histories.

company.description: Company slug or uuid, as returned by search_companies.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`.

role.description: Only exhibitor or sponsor records. Defaults to both.

name: exhibitor_history
title: Company exhibitor history
